about_the_game:
Explore, Fight, Seduce!—Carve your own path with the powers of lust!

As mortal enemies, the battle between demons and humans seemed to be dragging into eternity. But once the demon king was defeated, the demons fell into a state of chaos. A new power arose with one goal in mind...to claim the throne that dominates the demon race.

Succubus Successor is a seductive-themed Metroidvania. Play as a succubus on a mission to hunt down the demon lord. Use your powers of seduction to charm enemies and engage in intimate encounters. Explore a vast world and solve tricky puzzles to uncover dark secrets.

Awesome Gameplay + Steamy Scenes!

Play as a succubus who sucks the souls of enemies with aphrodisiac magic or extracts their life force by forcing them into heat. And to make this Metroidvania even spicier, a sex scene is triggered whenever a battle is lost. After all, there's more to war than just killing and gore...

Extract Life Force to Enhance Powers

Suck out the life force from aroused enemies and use it to upgrade your powers.

Puzzle Solving & Exploration

Use aphrodisiac magic to open up locked or hidden areas of the map, or put your new powers into action and head to new maps.

Super Sexy Stuff

Regardless of whether your enemy's a man or woman, force them into heat or extract their life force to trigger a sex scene.

Features

  • Hand-drawn pixel animation with adult content!

  • Explore an expansive map at your own pace, defeating tough enemies and unlocking new abilities.

  • Use succubus skills to suck out enemy life force—the perfect blend of sex and battle!

  • Exquisite pixelated animations and character visuals that bring to life the seductive charm of love...and war.

  • Inspired by retro gameplay, Succubus Successor features modern controls where players can upgrade their character by unlocking abilities through exploration and defeating enemies.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters depicted are 20 years of age or older. This game contains explicit sexual content, including scenes triggered by seduction and combat mechanics. It features themes of non-consensual sex, BDSM, mind control, group sex, and same-sex relations.

The game involves fantasy races (Orcs, Elves, Demons), Crossdressers, Futanari, Intersex characters, and supernatural elements (succubus abilities, aphrodisiac magic). All scenes are fictional and presented in a fantasy context.
